latePenalty.value: Quá hạn gốc: lãi suất bằng 150% lãi suất cho vay trong hạn (theo năm), tính từ ngày nợ gốc quá hạn. Lãi chậm trả lãi: 10%/năm. Khoản khác chậm trả: lãi suất cao nhất pháp luật quy định. Phạt vi phạm hợp đồng 8% dư nợ gốc còn lại nếu không báo đổi địa chỉ/liên lạc trong 05 ngày làm việc; 8% giá trị nghĩa vụ vi phạm nếu cung cấp thông tin sai hoặc vi phạm khác. Tính lãi theo năm 365 ngày.
latePenalty.note: General loan terms (Điều kiện giao dịch chung, Điều 5, 15); the product-specific contract (Điều Kiện Riêng) was not published, so the in-term rate that the 150% multiplies is product-specific.

products.notes: Rate quoted "từ X%/tháng (tính theo dư nợ ban đầu)", i.e. interest on the original balance, which we record as flat/monthly; the page does not use the word "phẳng". The published rate framework (effective 01/03/2026, https://lottefinance.vn/images/resources/file/KhungLaiSuat_100226.jpg) quotes %/năm and does not say flat or reducing, so do not equate it with this monthly figure. Rate framework row 4 (salaried): 8%-66%/year min-max, basis unstated. Extra eligibility: official labour contract, at least 3 months in official employment at state agencies (as worded on page), salary paid through a bank account. The calculator on the loan list page offers terms 6-60 months, but the product page says 6-36; we use the product page.

researchNotes: LICENSING: data/licensed-institutions.json did not exist when this was researched, so licensedInstitutionId "lotte-finance" could not be checked against it. The SBV finance-company page returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and was not worked around, so the SBV listing is NOT verified by this research. SOURCES: lottefinance.vn home and loan pages (static HTML), rate framework image "Khung lãi suất sản phẩm cho vay tiêu dùng" (effective 01/03/2026), early-repayment fee image (under Decision 26M135701/203 of 29/05/2026), general loan terms (https://lottefinance.vn/web/service/customer/termAndCond/loanTnC), borrower insurance page (https://lottefinance.vn/web/convenience/deptCancelSuspens). GAPS: (1) No minimum loan amount for any product. (2) No published representative example (monthly payment, total repaid, APR); the loan list page has a simulator, but the product list comes from an API (/api/loan/getLoanMainList) that was not called. (3) Product-specific contract terms (Điều Kiện Riêng) with the actual in-term rate, fees and early-repayment rule are not published; the general terms defer to them. (4) The rate framework gives %/year ranges per segment (salaried 8-66%, other-lender history 20-59%, life insurance 20-55%, women 20-66%) without flat/reducing basis, so the true ceiling per product is unknown (maxPercent left null). (5) Insurance premium and how it is collected not published. (6) Cash service fee amount not published. (7) Installment loans for goods appear only as rate framework section B (paid to merchants: 0-20% car, 0-30% medical, 0-66% other, 0-15% for union-introduced employees); no consumer-facing product page, so no product entry. (8) Credit cards (personal, Installment Card, L.Card) have fee/rate PDFs that could not be read with available tools; not captured. (9) Only four loan products are on the home page; the full list endpoint was not read, so other consumer products may exist (framework also lists state employee, retiree, business income, ride-hailing driver and good-Lotte-history segments). (10) App-based cash loan not verified; process described is consultation then contract signing at a location. POSSIBLE CONTRADICTIONS: product pages say terms 6-36 months while the list-page calculator offers 6-60 months. The framework minimum for salaried (8%/year) and the product page (0.94%/month on initial balance, about 11.3%/year nominal) quote different things and cannot be reconciled from published data. SURPRISING: early repayment is free for salaried, state-employee and other-lender-history products on contracts from 12/08/2025, but costs 6% of early-repaid principal (minimum 1,600,000 VND) for other consumer loans, which is large on small loans. Overdue principal accrues at 150% of the in-term annual rate, and 8% contract-violation penalties exist for not reporting address/contact changes within 5 working days. A 66%/year ceiling is published for several segments. | Legal name updated to the SBV list (as of 2026-09-30): the company converted to a general finance company and amended its name on 28/8/2026. Former name: Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV Lotte Việt Nam.
